answer: Rule: every identity publishes its work to a public lantern ledger, and the network measures the delta between each new output and all past outputs. Outputs closer than a fixed threshold count as clones, and the whole cluster burns its stake, 50 units per identity, under one ferrous rule with no appeal. One fake costs one genuinely distinct piece of work plus 50 units at risk; 100 fakes need 100 distinct works and risk 5,000 units, so the cost scales linearly in real work and linearly in stake.
